json.text: I tear the fabric of reality, calling upon the spectral forge.
Swords of pure arcana
obeying the caster's will are forged and delivered through dimensional rifts. When cast,
portals open before the sorcerer
, unleashing streams of arcane blades that seek out their foes.

The manifestation requires unwavering focus and considerable magical reserves. Each portal that tears through reality demands its own portion of my mana, yet the devastating potential of multiple spectral weapons makes this investment worthwhile.
I have found this spell particularly effective against groups of enemies, as each blade operates with its own targeting intelligence, ensuring that no foe escapes the arcane onslaught.
Warning:
Dynamic mana cost increases with all attributes. Formula: 0.5 × Magnitude × Speed × √Duration
I condense my mana into a
solid vortex that explodes with a powerful pulse
covering the surrounding area. Despite its deadly nature, a wise wizard can decide whether the spell will
affect soulless targets or the ones with it
This tactical masterpiece allows me to prepare magical effects that will trigger after a predetermined time, creating opportunities for strategic planning that would otherwise be impossible.
In my journeys I have found
ancient manuscripts describing techniques of projectile group creation
. This powerful shape demands concentration and patience to achieve its full potential.
Through
focused will alone
, I believe I can command these condensed energies to seek out and pursue their targets.
I have finally mastered the art of forming
substantial and stable projectiles
capable of affecting multiple targets across a greater area upon impact.
Alas, the
arcane density of these manifestations comes at the cost of velocity
- one must time their casting carefully to ensure the spell reaches its target before evasion becomes possible.
This intricate working allows me to
weave my will into the fabric of reality
, creating a field of power around myself. I may sustain this aura indefinitely, but upon my command, the
stored energies will instantly pierce everything inside the area
Should my concentration falter during the initial casting, the
delicate pattern collapses and the spell fails to manifest
